task.prediction_time: The public first-posting date of the registration record in statusModule.studyFirstPostDateStruct, before any enrollment result or completion status exists.
task.question: At the instant a trial record first becomes public on ClinicalTrials.gov, will that interventional trial eventually be recorded as TERMINATED (stopped early) rather than COMPLETED?
task.decision_user: A trial portfolio manager or research funder deciding which newly registered studies get accrual support, site monitoring or a design review before enrollment starts.

prediction_instant.citation: statusModule.studyFirstPostDateStruct; the registration record is public at this date

row_selection.rule: Include INTERVENTIONAL records with studyFirstPostDate from 2008-01-01 through 2016-12-31 and overallStatus at the 2026-11-08 snapshot equal to COMPLETED or TERMINATED; drop all other statuses and label TERMINATED as 1 and COMPLETED as 0.

selection.evidence: Population eligibility uses INTERVENTIONAL study type, the first-post window, and registration fields only. The terminal status at the 2026-11-08 snapshot is used solely to assign or drop the label; active and unknown statuses are excluded.

vintage.evidence: Records read on 2026-11-08; design and status values are current-vintage and historical availability at first posting is not proven.

cross_row_audit.auxiliary_files_review: Only public/train.csv, public/eval.csv and private/holdout.csv are written; no auxiliary label or answer-scaffold files are produced.
cross_row_audit.rationale: Each NCT ID contributes one isolated registration row; no cross-row features and no later-row label leakage.

limitations: Current-vintage snapshot read on 2026-11-08; design fields may be amended after first posting, so real-time availability at the decision instant is unverified.
Records not COMPLETED or TERMINATED at snapshot are dropped; this censors active and unknown studies and does not label them negative.
Termination is self-reported with variable lag, and some trials stopped early may be filed as COMPLETED, adding label noise.
No enrollment, completion date, why-stopped, results or outcome fields are used as inputs; they are post-outcome.
No persistence reference applies because each NCT ID appears once.
Condition mesh branch relies on the API derived browse branch; missing branches remain empty and are not imputed.
Age bounds and start_month preserve missing values; missing is not zero.
This is a retrospective risk-triage benchmark, not a causal or operational decision tool.

construction_notes: Uses two keyless ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 status sweeps for INTERVENTIONAL records first posted 2008-01-01 through 2016-12-31, paged with nextPageToken and a field-limited JSON request. One row per NCT ID. The target column is terminated, exactly matching quality.target; ID is nct_id; time and event key are first_post_date. Only declared ID, time, feature and target columns are written; no carry columns are declared. The published snapshot counts are checked against API totalCount and against fetched rows. The concrete publisher example NCT01533376 is checked for TERMINATED, PHASE1 and lead sponsor class OTHER. Feature coverage is checked so unresolved fields cannot ship as empty columns; missing values are left empty rather than zero-filled. Historical availability at the first-post instant is not proven by the 2026-11-08 current-vintage snapshot, so all feature-availability entries except the ID and time fields are marked assumed. Condition mesh branch uses the derived condition browse branch because the raw MeSH term list does not expose a top-level branch directly; if that derived field is absent, the coverage check fails with observed headers and missing names instead of fabricating branches. start_month is the integer calendar-month gap from statusModule.startDateStruct to studyFirstPostDateStruct, matching the supplied feature meaning about start month precision and the posting gap. No threshold is used. No persistence reference applies because each study appears once. No additional documentation was read; field names and semantics come from the supplied source evidence and the API data-structure field names. The builder writes only output and cache, and does not train, score, package, select features from holdout or change the frozen task.
